implementation.commands: dsh.registerCommand({name:'ulw'}) + dsh.registerCommand({name:'ultrawork'}) — bare names (the host parses the slash), input {hint:'objective'}, ONE handler; the returned host disposers + the gesture disposer are handed to the plugin fiber via ctx.effect when available.
implementation.turnSubmission: the handler calls `invocation.submit(dsh.userMessage({text: activationDirective(objective), source:{kind:'plugin',plugin:'mpd-ulw'}}))`; `submit` is bound by the adapter to `submitUserTurn(invocation.agent, message)` (t12), so the plugin never reads invocation.agent itself. Boolean true -> {kind:'success', text:'ULW activated: <objective>'}; false -> {kind:'error', text:'ULW could not start: no live agent turn surface …'}.
implementation.gesture: dsh.onEvent('agent/pre-step', async (payload, next) => …): awaits next() FIRST (waterfall discipline), returns the composed decision unchanged unless the latest user-role message text matches /^(?:\/ulw|\/ultrawork)(?:[\t\n\r ]+|$)/u, then returns {...decision, messages} with that message's first text block rewritten to the SAME activation directive (identity id/role/source preserved, mirroring the adopted consumeFlagFromMessage). A bare `/ulw` (no objective), a mid-text mention, a reject decision and a step without a user message are all returned untouched.
implementation.directive: exported ULW_ACTIVATION_DIRECTIVE + activationDirective(objective) — six clauses in order (triage -> gate -> team -> loop -> fix-on-sight -> close-out); stable head, objective appended last (DeepSeek V4 prefix-cache discipline). Deliberately NOT folded into the child-round DIRECTIVE (requirements contract §3).
